jobs.description_snippet: **Finance Business Analyst — M-KOPA South Africa** =================================================== ### **You've proven you can turn numbers into decisions. Now turn them into financial access for millions.** You're good at what you do. Budgets close on time, forecasts hold up, and when a business leader needs a straight answer on the numbers, they come to you. That's not nothing — most finance careers stall long before that level of trust is earned. But here's the question worth sitting with: how much of that trust is spent explaining what already happened, versus shaping what happens next? At M-KOPA, we're looking for a Finance Business Partner who's ready to spend less time reporting the past and more time building the future — for a business that's scaling access to essential assets across some of the fastest-growing consumer markets in Africa. **Where M-KOPA is right now** M-KOPA has grown to **10 million customers** — up from 5 million just a year ago — unlocking over **$2 billion** in credit for people who'd otherwise been shut out of formal financial services. **86% of our customers** report a real improvement in their quality of life, **70%** use what they've financed to generate income, and **55%** are accessing financial services for the very first time through us. Behind that: 2,300+ employees, 35,000+ agents, $45 million contributed in taxes, 2 million smartphones assembled in Kenya, and 4,000+ e-motorbikes financed — saving riders $5.62 a day. **Why now** If you've noticed M-KOPA advertising for several finance and business roles at once, that's not a coincidence. We're deliberately building out the finance function that will take us from 7 million customers to 10 million — and a Finance Business Partner sits right at the centre of that. This isn't about backfilling a gap. It's about putting the right commercial finance capability in place before we need it, not after. **What makes this different** In a lot of organisations, "business partnering" quietly becomes bookkeeping with better branding — reconciling accounts, chasing accruals, producing packs nobody reads closely. That's not this role. You'll be the person business leaders actually turn to before a decision gets made, not after. You'll build the business cases behind new market and product bets, challenge assumptions in budgets before they become commitments, and have a direct line into how M-KOPA allocates capital across a fast-moving, multi-market business. jobs.description_snippet: **Location:** 100% Remote (Global) **Timezone / Hours:** Flexible working hours, with a requirement for partial overlap with US business hours (PT/ET) for synchronous team collaboration and meetings. **Engagement Type:** Full-Time Independent Contractor ### **The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation** Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software. We operate two core platforms: **Customize Now** (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and **Source Anything** (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network). We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain. ### **The Role** We're not looking for a traditional data analyst. We don't need someone to sit between our systems and the business interpreting what the numbers mean. We need a builder who can take a stated requirement ("we need this tracked," "alert us when this breaks") and ship it: a dashboard, an automated pipeline, or a real-time alert. A significant part of this role is exposing what’s already happening across our platforms: tracking when something enters a process, when it exits, and pinpointing where it gets stuck. This is closer to an automation and systems engineering role than classic business intelligence. You will work alongside our core engineering team and our Automation Engineer to connect, clean, and automate our entire data ecosystem. We would rather hire someone scrappy and technical who figures things out (researches, builds, breaks things, and fixes them) than someone with a polished analytics background who needs well-defined problems handed to them. ### **The Big Vision** You will own data across the entire organization. We are actively moving away from static dashboards and toward an AI-powered data engine where team members can type in natural-language queries, and the engine automatically fetches, processes, and analyzes the data in real time. Ultimately, you will build the central data heart of THE/STUDIO—a system where automated, data-driven decisions execute seamlessly across our operations. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Architect the AI Data Engine:** Build toward our long-term vision of an AI-driven, natural-language query interface and contribute to automating operational decision-making across the business. * **Build Automated Pipelines \& Dashboards:** Design self-sustaining systems (e.g., Looker/Looker Studio or equivalent BI tools) where metrics populate automatically with zero manual pulling. * **Ship End-to-End Solutions Independently:** Take raw requirements from managers and build working
jobs.blurb: Data and Automation Systems Builder responsible for developing infrastructure and automation systems for a manufacturing-focused SaaS platform, fully remote with flexible hours.

jobs.description_snippet: **This is a software development job.** You'll design, build, test, debug, deploy and maintain real systems. What's different is how the code gets written. We use agentic coding tools as a default, so a lot of implementation gets drafted by an agent working under your direction. Your time shifts toward specifying precisely, reviewing carefully, and verifying rigorously. The bottleneck moves from typing code to judging it. Day to day you'll be building [product / systems] in [stack]. Normal engineering work, at unusual throughput. We want developers, full stop. If you can't read a stack trace and reason your way to the cause, these tools won't cover for you - they'll just help you produce bugs faster. If your experience is mostly using AI tools without a developers background, this isn't the right role for you. **What you'll do** * Break work into pieces an agent can execute and you can verify * Review a high volume of generated code and catch the plausible-but-wrong * Debug systems you didn't write line by line * Build the guardrails that make speed safe: tests, types, linting, CI * Own what ships. "The agent wrote it" isn't a defence * Bring back what you learn about where the tools break **What we need** * **Real software fundamentals** - data structures, APIs, databases, and the ability to reason about correctness, performance and failure modes * **Debugging ability.** You can find the cause, not just the symptom * **Strong code review instincts.** The highest-leverage skill on this team * **Git, CI/CD and command-line comfort** * **Testing discipline** - you don't trust code you haven't verified * **Clear writing.** Vague instructions produce vague software * **Honesty about uncertainty.** "I don't understand this yet" is a feature **By level** * **Junior:** solid fundamentals and evidence you build things. Portfolio, personal projects or coursework is fine - we'll teach the workflow. * **Mid:** 3+ years shipping production code, and you've already worked this way on something real. * **Senior:** you can design systems, set standards for how the team works with agents, and mentor people through the shift. **Bonus points** * Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic tools * **Print industry experience** - prepress, PDF/PostScript workflows, colour management, variable data printing, web-to-print, or print MIS * Familiarity with MCP or tool integrations * Open-source contributions Pay: R10 000,00 - R30 000,00 per month Work Location: In person
